final: WITH channel_averages AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink COLLATE BINARY = o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY o.orderbase), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM channel_averages) SELECT AVG(c.avg_fee_rate) AS avg_kept_fee_rate, AVG(c.avg_fee_rate - a.avg_fee_rate) AS avg_excess_fee_rate FROM channel_averages AS c JOIN overall AS a ON a.avg_fee_rate IS NOT NULL WHERE c.avg_fee_rate > a.avg_fee_rate
